cues.en: Now that we're done with our makefile tasks, let's resume our auth functionality.
cues.zh: Makefile 工作完成後，繼續處理驗證功能。

cues.en: We had already created the user model previously.
cues.zh: 之前已建立 User 模型。

cues.en: We can now create some auth related utility functions that are going to help us to generate an OTP, generate a username, verify the passwords, etc..
cues.zh: 現在建立驗證相關的工具函式，協助產生 OTP、使用者名稱，以及驗證密碼等。

cues.en: So you can do is we're going to go to the backend, then app, then auth folder.
cues.zh: 前往 backend/app/auth 資料夾。

cues.en: Then within this folder we're going to create a new file that's going to be called utils dot pi like that.
cues.zh: 在裡面新增 utils.py。

cues.en: Then as usual we start with our imports.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，先匯入。

cues.en: As you can see import random.
cues.zh: 匯入 random，

cues.en: Then you're going to import a string.
cues.zh: 再匯入 string。

cues.en: Then from backend.app.co dot config we're going to import settings.
cues.zh: 從 backend.app.core.config 匯入 settings。

cues.en: Then from argon2 we're going to import the password hasher.
cues.zh: 從 argon2 匯入 PasswordHasher。

cues.en: Then from Argon2 dot exceptions we're going to import the verify mismatch error.
cues.zh: 從 argon2.exceptions 匯入 VerifyMismatchError。

cues.en: Then we're going to create a password hash object.
cues.zh: 接著建立密碼雜湊物件。

cues.en: This is going to be used to hash and verify passwords as you can see underscore pH.
cues.zh: 用它進行密碼雜湊與驗證，名稱是 _ph。

cues.en: So this underscore is used to indicate that this is a private variable.
cues.zh: 前導底線表示這是私有變數。

cues.en: Private variables are not meant to be accessed outside this particular module.
cues.zh: 私有變數不打算讓此模組外部存取。

cues.en: So you can see underscore pH.
cues.zh: 所以設定 _ph，

cues.en: That's going to be password hasher.
cues.zh: 值是 PasswordHasher()。

cues.en: Then the first function is going to be the one to help us generate a random OTP of six digits.
cues.zh: 第一個函式，協助產生六位數的隨機 OTP。

cues.en: As you can see define generate underscore OTP.
cues.zh: 定義 generate_otp。

cues.en: It's going to take in a parameter of length of type integer.
cues.zh: 接受 int 型別的 length，

cues.en: And we're going to set it to six.
cues.zh: 預設設為 6。

cues.en: Then the function is going to return a string.
cues.zh: 函式傳回 str。

cues.en: Our OTP are going to be used to verify the user login.
cues.zh: OTP 會用來驗證使用者登入，

cues.en: Amongst other use cases.
cues.zh: 以及其他用途。

cues.en: So within our function we can now say OTP is going to be empty string dot join I'm going to explain this.
cues.zh: 函式裡設定 otp，使用空字串的 join，稍後解釋。

cues.en: Then we're going to pass in random dot choices.
cues.zh: 傳入 random.choices。

cues.en: Then a string dot digits with the k value equivalent to the length, which in our case is going to be six.
cues.zh: 來源是 string.digits，k 設為 length，這裡是 6。

cues.en: So here this expression is used to join the elements of the list into a string.
cues.zh: 這個運算式會將清單元素串接成字串。

cues.en: The random dot choices.
cues.zh: random.choices，

cues.en: This function is used to generate a list of random choices from the string, dot digits, and string digits.
cues.zh: 會從 string.digits 隨機選取元素，產生清單。而 string.digits，

cues.en: This is a string of digits from 0 to 9.
cues.zh: 是包含 0 到 9 的數字字串。

cues.en: Then, when we say k is equivalent to the length, this is the length of the list to be generated, which in our case is going to be the length of the OTP, which is a six characters.
cues.zh: k=length 指定要產生的清單長度，也就是 OTP 的長度，這裡是六個字元。

cues.en: Then we're just going to return the OTP like that.
cues.zh: 最後傳回 otp。

cues.en: Then the next function is going to be the one to help us generate a password hash.
cues.zh: 下一個函式協助產生密碼雜湊。

cues.en: So you can say define generate underscore password underscore hash.
cues.zh: 定義 generate_password_hash。

cues.en: That's going to take in a password of type string.
cues.zh: 傳入 str 型別的 password。

cues.en: And the function returns a string.
cues.zh: 函式傳回 str。

cues.en: Then for this function we're just going to return the hashed password using the password hash object that we defined above.
cues.zh: 使用上面定義的密碼雜湊物件，傳回雜湊後的密碼。

cues.en: So here we can just say return underscore pH.
cues.zh: 寫 return _ph。

cues.en: Remember we defined this password hash object up above.
cues.zh: 記得，上面已定義這個密碼雜湊物件。

cues.en: Then we can say hash.
cues.zh: 再接 .hash，

cues.en: And again to hash the password like that.
cues.zh: 傳入 password，進行雜湊。

cues.en: Then the next function is going to be the one to verify a password hash.
cues.zh: 下一個函式驗證密碼雜湊。

cues.en: As you can see define verify underscore password that's going to take in a password of type string.
cues.zh: 定義 verify_password，傳入 str 型別的 password，

cues.en: Then the hashed password of type string.
cues.zh: 以及 str 型別的 hashed_password。

cues.en: And this function returns a boolean.
cues.zh: 函式傳回 bool。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 接著加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: Within our try block we're going to verify the password against the hashed password by saying return underscore ph dot.
cues.zh: 在 try 裡，比對密碼與雜湊後密碼，寫 return _ph，

cues.en: Verify passing in the hashed password and the password.
cues.zh: 接 .verify，傳入 hashed_password 與 password。

cues.en: Then if there's any mismatch error, we're going to return false.
cues.zh: 若有不相符錯誤，就傳回 False。

cues.en: As you can see except verify mismatch error.
cues.zh: 寫 except VerifyMismatchError。

cues.en: We're just going to return false like that.
cues.zh: 再 return False。

cues.en: Then the next function is going to be the one to help us generate usernames automatically.
cues.zh: 下一個函式協助自動產生使用者名稱。

cues.en: We are a bank and we need standard usernames for our customers.
cues.zh: 我們是銀行，需要為客戶產生標準格式的使用者名稱。

cues.en: As you can see define generate username.
cues.zh: 定義 generate_username。

cues.en: That function returns a string.
cues.zh: 函式傳回 str。

cues.en: First we're going to have a bank name variable where we get our bank name from our settings.
cues.zh: 先建立 bank_name 變數，從 settings 取得銀行名稱。

cues.en: As you can see, bank name that's going to be a settings dot site name.
cues.zh: 也就是 bank_name = settings.SITE_NAME。

cues.en: Then we're going to split the bank name into a list of words.
cues.zh: 再將銀行名稱拆成單字清單。

cues.en: As you can see ones that's going to be bank name dot split.
cues.zh: 設定 words = bank_name.split()。

cues.en: Then we're going to join the first letter of each word in the list.
cues.zh: 接著串接清單中每個字的第一個字母。

cues.en: We're going to be using list comprehension for this.
cues.zh: 這裡使用清單生成式的方式處理。

cues.en: As you can see the prefix that's going to be quotation marks.
cues.zh: 設定 prefix，先用引號表示空字串，

cues.en: Then we're going to use our list comprehension and say in brackets word at index zero.
cues.zh: 再取得每個 word 的索引 0，

cues.en: That is the first letter of each word for word in words.
cues.zh: 也就是 for word in words，取出各單字的首字母。

cues.en: Then you're going to make the first letter an uppercase.
cues.zh: 再將首字母轉為大寫。

cues.en: So chain dot upper like that.
cues.zh: 串接後呼叫 .upper()。

cues.en: Let me explain here.
cues.zh: 解釋一下。

cues.en: We're using list comprehension to get the first letter of each word in our list.
cues.zh: 這裡透過生成式，取得清單中每個字的第一個字母。

cues.en: And so, for example, if our site name is something like, let's say next gen banking like that, then
cues.zh: 例如 SITE_NAME 是 NextGen Banking，

cues.en: our prefix from what you're doing on this line right here is going to result in a prefix of n b like that.
cues.zh: 這一行就會得到 NB 這個前綴。

cues.en: And so that's what we're trying to achieve.
cues.zh: 這就是我們要的結果。

cues.en: And this converts the concatenated string to uppercase.
cues.zh: upper 將串接後的字串轉成大寫。

cues.en: So we are trying to achieve something like this.
cues.zh: 我們要產生這樣的前綴。

cues.en: So after setting the prefix what you're going to do is we're going to calculate the remaining length for the random characters by subtracting the length of the prefix from 12.
cues.zh: 前綴設定好後，從 12 減去前綴長度，計算隨機字元剩餘的長度。

cues.en: This is because our username is supposed to be 12 characters long.
cues.zh: 因為使用者名稱應該長十二個字元。

cues.en: So you can say remaining length.
cues.zh: 設定 remaining_length，

cues.en: That's going to be 12 minus the length over prefix, then minus one like that.
cues.zh: 值是 12 - len(prefix) - 1。

cues.en: And we're subtracting this one because we're going to add a hyphen between the prefix and the random string.
cues.zh: 再減 1，是因為前綴與隨機字串之間要加連字號。

cues.en: Then we can say for random string is going to be quotation marks again.
cues.zh: 接著 random_string 也使用空字串，

cues.en: Then dot join.
cues.zh: 呼叫 .join。

cues.en: And we're going to pass in random choices.
cues.zh: 傳入 random.choices。

cues.en: So random dot choices then pass in the string dot ascii uppercase characters Plus a string dot digits.
cues.zh: 來源是 string.ascii_uppercase + string.digits。

cues.en: Then set the value of k to the remaining length.
cues.zh: k 設為 remaining_length。

cues.en: Just like that.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: Let me explain what's going on here.
cues.zh: 解釋一下。

cues.en: So here we're generating a random string of the remaining length.
cues.zh: 這裡會產生長度為 remaining_length 的隨機字串。

cues.en: And when you say string dot ascii uppercase this is going to be a string of uppercase letters from A to Z.
cues.zh: string.ascii_uppercase 是 A 到 Z 的大寫字母字串。

cues.en: Then string dot digits which is right there.
cues.zh: 這裡的 string.digits，

cues.en: That's going to be a string of digits from 0 to 9.
cues.zh: 則是 0 到 9 的數字字串。

cues.en: Then random dot choices.
cues.zh: random.choices，

cues.en: This is a function that is going to be used to generate a list of random choices from the string dot, sk uppercase, and the string of digits.
cues.zh: 會從大寫字母與數字字串，隨機選取元素，產生清單。

cues.en: Then the k is set to the remaining length.
cues.zh: k 設為 remaining_length。

cues.en: This is the length of the list to be generated, which is the remaining length for our random string.
cues.zh: 這是要產生的清單長度，也就是隨機字串剩餘的長度。

cues.en: Then lastly, we're going to concatenate the prefix and the random string with the hyphen in between to generate our username.
cues.zh: 最後，串接前綴與隨機字串，中間加連字號，產生使用者名稱。

cues.en: As you can see, username that's going to be enough strings.
cues.zh: 設定 username，使用 f-string。

cues.en: We're going to set our prefix, then add a hyphen.
cues.zh: 先放 prefix，再加連字號，

cues.en: Then curly braces add in our random string like that.
cues.zh: 再用大括號加入 random_string。

cues.en: Then we just return the username like that.
cues.zh: 最後傳回 username。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And that's it for this lecture on our utility functions.
cues.zh: 工具函式這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture we're going to be setting up our email configuration.
cues.zh: 下一堂課設定電子郵件組態。
